clips.title: The story
paras: The Everstill Bridge is a rebuilding effort led by Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire to repair the town's damaged stone bridge. Progress has ground to a halt because iron meant for the project was redirected into weapons during the last orc invasion, and the replacement caravan from Stormwind was ambushed by Redridge gnolls.

The stone bridge spanning Lake Everstill is the lifeblood of Lakeshire, connecting the western roads back toward Elwynn Forest with the far bank and the northern passes. During the recent orc incursions, the town was pushed to the brink. With survival hanging in the balance, Lakeshire melted down its structural iron supplies to forge munitions, blades, and plate armor to repel the Blackrock invaders, leaving the bridge incomplete and vulnerable.

Foreman Oslow petitioned the House of Nobles and Stormwind for fresh construction materials to finish repairs. A supply caravan laden with iron was dispatched, but it never arrived. A warband of Redridge gnolls ambushed the convoy along the road, carting away vital iron pikes and rivets into their camps in the northern hills. Without adventurous travelers willing to reclaim the stolen hardware, the bridge project remains stalled while gnolls and orcs tighten their grip on the mountains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor. We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.
Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt. If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, friend, I'll make sure you're rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This bridge isn't going to build itself! Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great work, friend. These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
